title: ✈️ sarnia — Jul 19, 2026
itinerary_text:
## 🚗 ROAD TRIP OVERVIEW

*   **Route:** 8 Harridine Rd, Brampton to Windsor (2-hour stop), then to Sarnia.
*   **Total Driving Distance:** Approx. 560 km (Brampton → Windsor → Sarnia).
*   **Total Driving Time:** Approx. 6 hours and 15 minutes of pure driving time.
*   **Rest Stop Recommendation:** Your required 2-hour stop in **Windsor** acts as the perfect mid-way break. It breaks the journey into a 3.5-hour drive (Brampton to Windsor) and a 1.5-hour drive (Windsor to Sarnia).

---

## Day 1 – Sunday, July 19: The Journey & World Cup Kickoff
*Focus: Efficiency and Sports*

*   **07:00 AM – 10:30 AM:** Depart Brampton. Drive to Windsor.
*   **10:30 AM – 12:30 PM:** **Windsor Stop.** Grab brunch at *The Loose Goose* (spacious, great for groups). Walk along the Detroit River waterfront for relaxation.
*   **12:30 PM – 02:00 PM:** Drive from Windsor to Sarnia (via Highway 401/40).
*   **02:00 PM – 03:00 PM:** Check into the hotel and settle in. 
*   **03:00 PM – 05:00 PM:** **WORLD CUP WATCH PARTY:** Head to *Ups N Downs* or *Brownstones* in Sarnia. Both offer large screens and great pub atmosphere for a group of 3.
*   **05:00 PM – 07:00 PM:** Relax at Centennial Park. 
*   **07:00 PM – 08:30 PM:** Dinner at *Alternate Grounds Dockside* (Waterfront views).

---

## Day 2 – Monday, July 20: Sarnia Exploration
*Focus: Adventure & Shopping*

*   **09:00 AM – 10:30 AM:** Breakfast at *Scroggins Breakfast & Lunch*.
*   **10:30 AM – 01:30 PM:** **Adventure:** Canatara Park. Enjoy the beach, picnic area, and walking trails. It is perfect for a group of 3 to lounge or rent kayaks if available.
*   **01:30 PM – 03:00 PM:** Quick Lunch at the park.
*   **03:00 PM – 06:00 PM:** **Shopping:** Visit Lambton Mall for some retail therapy.
*   **06:00 PM – 08:00 PM:** Dinner at *Los Puntos Cantina* (Excellent tacos/Mexican food, great for groups).

---

## Day 3 – Tuesday, July 21: Final Relaxation
*Focus: Leisurely pace before departure*

*   **09:30 AM – 11:00 AM:** Breakfast at *Bad Dog Bar & Grill*.
*   **11:00 AM – 02:00 PM:** Visit the Sarnia Children’s Animal Farm (inside Canatara Park) or stroll the downtown boutique shops.
*   **02:00 PM – 04:00 PM:** Late lunch at *Refined Fool Brewing Co.* (They offer amazing craft beers and rotate food trucks/partners).
*   **04:00 PM – 07:00 PM:** Evening relaxation/leisure time back at the hotel or waterfront.
*   **07:00 PM – 08:30 PM:** Farewell dinner at *Crabbie's* (known for seafood and casual atmosphere).

---

## 🏨 Hotel Recommendations
*Recommendations allow for 3 guests (Two Queen Beds or One King + Sofa Bed)*

1.  **Best Western Plus Guildwood Inn:** Reliable, offers rooms with two queens, includes breakfast.
2.  **Holiday Inn Express Sarnia Point Edward:** Modern, comfortable, highly rated for groups, includes breakfast to save on costs.

---

## 📊 TRIP SUMMARY (Per Person / Total)

| Item | Cost Per Person (Est.) | Total Group Cost (3 People) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gas (Brampton-Windsor-Sarnia-Brampton)** | $50 | $150 |
| **Hotel (2 Nights, shared room)** | $160 | $480 |
| **Food & Drink ($60/day)** | $180 | $540 |
| **Activities/Misc** | $60 | $180 |
| **TOTAL** | **$450** | **$1,350** |

*Note: The group will depart on July 22nd at 11:00 AM. Ensure you check out of the hotel by 11:00 AM sharp to avoid late fees.*
